_doc: Hand-kept pointers for LAYERS.md (scripts/dev/make_layers_md.py). One row per layer family. 'layers' lists the layer_map.json layer ids of the family: every layer_map layer belongs to exactly one family, and its backtest rows are listed under the family automatically, so 'results' holds only reports that are not layer_map backtest rows. Task cards join a family by their 'layers' field (tasks.py new --layer <family>); 'cards' globs only catch cards without that field (Codex lab cards). Every path must exist (scripts/dev/test_make_layers_md.py, gate step 3ly). 'path' (2026-10-13, MTS Layers page): the standard road every layer walks (idea, inputs, fees, charts, built, dev, oos, testnet), each step {s: done|now|planned|later|missing|failed|skip, note, cards}; 'plain' is one line in plain words. The page (scripts/dev/make_layers_board.py) reads it; keep it true when a card lands.
